senses.sense_definition: A person who dresses in clothes traditionally associated with the opposite sex; a cross-dresser.

examples.text: The theater production featured a <w>transvestite</w> character who performed flamboyant musical numbers.
Historically, the term <w>transvestite</w> was widely used before cross-dresser became more common.

traits.comment: often replaced by cross-dresser or related modern terms

senses.sense_definition: A person who derives sexual excitement from wearing clothes of the opposite sex, historically classified as a paraphilic condition.

examples.text: Early psychological literature frequently studied the <w>transvestite</w> in clinical case reports.
The psychiatric handbook defined a <w>transvestite</w> in terms of recurrent urges and distress.

traits.comment: clinical usage largely superseded by transvestic disorder

senses.sense_definition: An animal that displays sexual mimicry, such as a male mimicking female behavior or appearance.

examples.text: Biologists observed that the male scorpion fly acted as a <w>transvestite</w> to steal food from rivals.
By behaving like a female, the <w>transvestite</w> animal managed to avoid dangerous conflicts.
